content.text:
I've submitted index 21 (La 0.49 / Sb 0.51, the composition of LaSbO₄) as the best composition. Its measured EQE was only about 0.0007%, which is effectively no photoresponse. All three merit measurements are used up.

| Index | Composition (La / Sb) | Nearby known phase | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 21 | 0.49 / 0.51 | LaSbO₄ | 0.00070 |
| 12 | 0.74 / 0.26 | La₃SbO₇ | −0.00013 |
| 25 | 0.38 / 0.62 | La₃Sb₅O₁₂ | −0.00095 |

- **How I picked the points:** I chose the first two because their compositions match known La–Sb oxide compounds from the Materials Project database. The third came from the Gaussian-process model's suggestion.
- **What the numbers mean:** these compounds are expected to have band gaps too wide for 3.2 eV light to excite, which fits signals this close to zero. The gaps between the three values are probably mostly noise, so I can't say this is the best composition in the library with any confidence. I measured only 3 of the 29 compositions and left the Sb-richest end (indexes 26–28) and the La-richest end (indexes 0–11) unmeasured.
- **XRD:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phases at these points weren't checked and the phase labels above are inferred from composition only.
